verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships an official `lms` CLI with documented commands (chat, get, load, server start/stop) and a headless daemon variant (llmster) for CI/servers, all first-party documented at lmstudio.ai/docs/cli, with community corroboration of headless usage being valuable for real tool integration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of CLI reliability/edge cases beyond docs and one community mention.
